blocking_note: PROVISIONAL. Labels come from the r15 auditor verdicts and one reviewing labeler. Two independent human labelers must answer the north-star question for every must_pass row, and only unanimous rows may stay, before this set gates production. Until then it gates the deterministic half of the contract in tests only. Rows in this file gate the deterministic half in tests; the live judge is gated by the calibrate-standalone harness, which needs a paid, captain-approved run before any judge prompt ships.
held_out: No row in this file may be used to iterate the prompt text. Add a held-out slice before the first production release.
north_star: Can a strong scientist who cannot see the paper state what the task asks for, name the kind of answer it wants, and resolve every referent from the displayed text alone? The scientist is not expected to know the measured value.
release_rule: No must_fail row may pass the composed gate decision, and at least 80 percent of must_pass rows must pass it.
